name: Blizz Finance
rootCause: The Luna fall-out continues. Venus Protocol on BSC and Blizz Finance on Avalanche have been drained of $13.5 and $8.3M, respectively. With shaky markets, and the first projects falling victim to the failure of LUNA and UST, how far will the damage spread?

descriptions.text: The Luna fall-out continues. Venus Protocol on BSC and Blizz Finance on Avalanche have been drained of $13.5 and $8.3M, respectively. With shaky markets, and the first projects falling victim to the failure of LUNA and UST, how far will the damage spread?

Avalanche lending protocol Blizz Finance tweeted that Chainlink suspended LUNA oracles, allowing several attackers to deposit millions of LUNA and borrow all collateral at $0.1 per Chainlink oracle. Due to the timelock mechanism, the protocol assets are exhausted before the team is suspended. According to DeFi Llama data, the agreement’s TVL was $8.28 million yesterday, and it is now 0.

Blizz Finance was exploited on Avalanche on May 13, 2022, when its LUNA market oracle price stopped updating. Attackers deposited heavily devalued LUNA, overborrowed assets, and drained the protocol, causing a reported loss of $8.3M. The Chainlink LUNA/USD price feed circuit breaker halted updates at $0.10, causing Blizz Finance's Aave-based oracle integration to continue valuing LUNA at this stale price. The protocol lacked a mechanism to pause the LUNA market or block invalid collateral, allowing attackers to overborrow assets against near-worthless LUNA.
